Posts behind this reading

These are Google News RSS indexed X posts. A post missing here may still exist on X.

How to read this experiment

Warmth is a provisional score based only on indexed posts whose titles explicitly mention Jean Phil or Jean Philanthrope in the preceding two hours. The curve is 100 × (1 − e^(−posts/8)). Coin-only mentions are shown separately to reduce price-driven social contamination. No likes, views, reposts, Instagram metrics, or unique-account counts are included. A zero means none appeared in this sample, not that there was no attention. The monitor starts collecting history when deployed; gaps are left blank. Correlation does not establish which side caused a move.
